=== Toggle done adds a checked box to an item without one
--- given
- ab‸c
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [x] ab‸c

=== Toggle done unchecks a checked box
--- given
- [x] ab‸c
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [ ] ab‸c

=== Toggle done checks an unchecked box
--- given
- [ ] a‸
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [x] a‸

=== Toggle done turns any other state into unchecked
--- given
- [-] a‸
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [ ] a‸

=== Toggle done works from a notes line and leaves the cursor there
--- given
- a
  no‸te
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [x] a
  no‸te

=== Toggle done leaves the children alone
--- given
- a‸
  - [ ] b
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [x] a‸
  - [ ] b

=== Toggle done on a bare bullet adds the box and a gap
--- given
-‸
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [x]‸

=== Toggle done on an empty item adds the box with no trailing gap
--- given
- ‸
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [x]‸

=== Toggle done with whole items selected toggles each on its own
--- given
⟨- a
- [x] b
- [ ] c⟩
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
⟨- [x] a
- [ ] b
- [x] c⟩

=== Toggle done keeps a cursor at the content start on the content
--- given
- ‸abc
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
- [x] ‸abc

=== Toggle done on an ordered item keeps the number
--- given
2. a‸
--- when command toggle-done
--- then
2. [x] a‸
